<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2162040_documate.fieldMappingUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>fieldMappingUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var fieldMappingUtils = Class.create();
fieldMappingUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    tempRetrive: function(current) {
		//delete previous

        var html = current.getValue('html_template');

    },

    extractFieldTokens: function(text) {
        var tokens = [];
        var found = {};

        if (!text)
            return tokens;

        //  * ${number}
        //  * ${short_description}
        
        var regex = /(^|[^\$])\$\{([^}]+)\}/g;
        var match;

        while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
            var token = match[2].trim();

            if (!found[token]) {
                found[token] = true;
                tokens.push(token);
            }
        }

        return tokens;
    },

    extractSectionTokens: function(text) {
        var sections = [];
        var found = {};

        if (!text)
            return sections;

        //  * $${captured_updates}
        //  * $${approvals}

        var regex = /\$\$\{([^}]+)\}/g;
        var match;

        while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
            var sectionName = match[1].trim();

            if (!found[sectionName]) {
                found[sectionName] = true;
                sections.push(sectionName);
            }
        }

        return sections;
    },

    type: 'fieldMappingUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-30 18:54:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>d1929378c39c5f1076cbbecdd4013157</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>fieldMappingUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="DocuMate" source="x_2162040_documate">0b329140c358971076cbbecdd4013131</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="DocuMate">0b329140c358971076cbbecdd4013131</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_d1929378c39c5f1076cbbecdd4013157</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-30 18:54:55</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
